parameters.content:
## 16 Safety Rails

The guardrail sub-workflow every sending workflow calls: kill switch, suppression, consent, rate limit, spend cap.

**Safety rails:** This IS the rails. It calls nothing and denies by default: any missing input, failed lookup or unknown channel returns allowed=false.

**Before you enable this:** replace every REPLACE_WITH_* value, point CRM_BASE_URL/CRM_ADAPTER at your CRM, and run it once manually with test data.

Docs: README.md, docs/SETUP.md, docs/COMPLIANCE.md

nodes.name: Called By Any Workflow
nodes.notes: Every workflow in the pack that can reach a prospect calls this first.

nodes.name: Check Kill Switch
nodes.notes: One row per scope. Set global to true and the whole pack stops sending.

nodes.name: Deny Kill Switch
nodes.notes: Malformed requests are denied here too - deny by default.

parameters.query:
=SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM suppression_list s
          WHERE s.identifier IN (nullif('{{ $('Normalize Rails Input').item.json.request.contact_email }}', ''),
                                 nullif('{{ $('Normalize Rails Input').item.json.request.contact_phone }}', ''),
                                 nullif('{{ $('Normalize Rails Input').item.json.request.contact_handle }}', ''))) AS suppressed,
  (SELECT c.basis FROM consent_ledger c
   WHERE c.identifier = nullif('{{ $('Normalize Rails Input').item.json.identifier }}', '')
     AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL
   ORDER BY c.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS consent_basis,
  (SELECT c.recorded_at FROM consent_ledger c
   WHERE c.identifier = nullif('{{ $('Normalize Rails Input').item.json.identifier }}', '')
     AND c.withdrawn_at IS NULL
   ORDER BY c.recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1) AS consent_recorded_at;

=SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM touch_log t
   WHERE t.direction = 'outbound' AND t.channel = '{{ $json.request.channel }}'
     AND t.occurred_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour') AS channel_last_hour,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM touch_log t
   WHERE t.direction = 'outbound' AND t.occurred_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 day') AS all_last_day;

nodes.name: Deny Rate Limit
nodes.notes: Denied, not queued. A rate limit that silently queues is a rate limit that eventually floods.

parameters.query:
=INSERT INTO rails_decisions (workflow, channel, purpose, identifier, allowed, code, reason, decided_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.request.workflow }}', '{{ $json.request.channel }}', '{{ $json.request.purpose }}',
        nullif('{{ $json.request.contact_email }}', ''), {{ $json.allowed }},
        '{{ $json.code }}', '{{ $json.reason }}', NOW());

nodes.name: Record Decision
nodes.notes: Every decision, allow and deny, is logged. This table is the audit trail you show a client when they ask why a message did or did not go out.
